svg.title: Mobile scaffold tower — Hjólavinnupallur
svg.desc: A three-dimensional rolling scaffold has a raised top deck, a braced front face and three visible castors.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-mobile-scaffold-tower","label_en":"Mobile scaffold tower","label_is":"Hjólavinnupallur","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["access","scaffold"],"description":"A three-dimensional rolling scaffold has a raised top deck, a braced front face and three visible castors.","design_note":"Perspective depth and caster-supported legs make a mobile tower distinct from a flat facade scaffold.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
